issues.legal_issue: A pending appeal from a possession decree passed before rent-control protection became applicable to the area is governed by the law applicable when the decree was passed, including when the original possession suit was brought under general property law.
material_facts: The landlord brought an ejectment suit under the general law governing property after the tenant’s lease had expired and the tenant did not comply with a notice to vacate.
The trial court entered a possession decree before rent-control protection applied to the area.
The tenant appealed, and rent-control protection was extended to the area while the appeal was pending.
issues.conclusion: The appeal had to be decided under the law applicable before rent-control protection was extended to the area. The tenant could not rely on the new protection to defeat the possession decree.
issues.legal_principle: Section 50 of the Bombay Rents, Hotel and Lodging House Rates Control Act, 1947, read as a whole with its proviso and the separate paragraph added by Bombay Act 3 of 1949, is an independent substantive saving provision. It extends the Act’s protection to specified pending suits and original proceedings, but excludes appeals arising from decrees or orders passed before the Act applied; those appeals are disposed of under the law previously applicable. This provision applies even when the original suit was brought under the Transfer of Property Act. Although section 12(1) is retrospective in operation under Shah Bhojraj Kuverji Oil Mills and Ginning Factory v. Subhash Chandra Yograj Sinha, and Chandrasingh Manibhai v. Surjit Lal Ladhamal Chhaabda considered the exclusion of appeals under the proviso, the special saving provision in section 50 prevails over the general protection in section 12(1). The Court approved Shankarlal Ramrotan v. Pandharinath Vishnu on the nature of the proviso.

predicates.pending_appeal_from_possession_decree: A tenant appealed from a decree ordering possession, and the appeal remained pending.
predicates.decree_predated_rent_protection: The possession decree was passed before rent-control protection applied to the area.
predicates.protection_extended_during_appeal: Rent-control protection was extended to the area while the appeal was pending.

issues.definition: When a tenant’s appeal from a possession decree remains pending, the decree predates the extension of rent-control protection, and that protection is extended during the appeal, the appeal is governed by the law that applied before the extension.
